sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 10715 of 2024

Applicant :- Suraj Pal
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Deptt. Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Atul Verma,Akhilendra Pratap Singh,Vinod Kumar Yadav
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and Sri Laxmi Narain Gupta,
learned Counsel for the complainant and perused the record.
2.
The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.148 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Kakori, District Lucknow.
3. It is argued by the Counsel for the applicant that the mother-in-law and the father-in-law have been enlarged on bail.
The applicant is the husband of the deceased.
4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering and adopting the same reasoning as contained in the order dated 03.09.2024 passed Suraj Pal vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 4 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/6962912/
1 in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.9398 of 2024 coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents and is languishing in jail since 19.06.2024, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.9398 of 2024
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicantSuraj Pal be released on bail in the abovesaid first information report number on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 4.10.2024 akverma  Suraj Pal vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 4 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/6962912/
